1879060811.Skill_Desc: Heals Morale in a time of need.\n\nBriefly protects you, while damaging enemies who attack you.

1879064395.Skill_Desc: This fellowship skill does minor direct ranged damage to your target, then more damage over time and can contribute to fellowship manoeuvres.

1879073739.Skill_Desc: A bite injecting a poison which weakens the target and can stun them if not cured.

1879104843.Skill_Desc: A gourd thrown at the target plagues them with spores, attacking their heart and weakening their resolve. This skill is only effective against players.

1879136971.Skill_Desc: A high damage attack that cannot miss, be blocked or parried.

1879160011.Skill_Desc: A pony from the Spring Festival.
1879160011.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available in the Spring Festival for Mithril Coins. Also available from the 'Pick a Mount' package.

1879213899.Skill_Desc: Your fellowship attempts to strike Draigoch with a final blow.

1879215691.Skill_Desc: A powerful strike that damages your foe and deals damage-over-time to the target.\n\nThis skill is more difficult for your enemies to avoid.

1879232331.Skill_Desc:
Stacking fire damage-over-time.

May be applied up to three times, increasing the Writ's tier.

+20% damage per tier increase.

1879232459.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available for barter when Kindred with the Riders of Stangard.

1879242315.Skill_Desc: One with nature and the elements the Mearas are adepts at using the natural world against their enemies; as students of nature, beasts and hidden lore so too are Lore-masters who study these wild horses.

1879244875.Skill_Desc: This quick strike saps your target's morale and has a chance on a critical strike to restore power to you and your war-steed.

1879255499.Skill_Desc: You hurl a lens toward your target distracting and potentially dismounting them. The glimmering light will attract a murder of crows to hamper the target's movement once the distraction dissipates.\n\n<rgb=#ff6600>This skill cannot be used on a target under the effects of 'Murder of Crows' the movement reducing effect applied by Radiant Burst.</rgb>

1879270475.Skill_Desc: Consume all of your Advanced Technique to reduce the damage you and your allies take for a brief time.\n\nThe potency of this effect increases for each Advanced Technique consumed.

1879276107.Skill_Desc: Your attackers' onslaught finds fewer holes in your defences, reducing the damage you take.

1879302603.Skill_Desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Hope into battle. This banner increases the mitigations of those around it.
1879302603.Skill_Name: Call to Arms: Herald of Hope (Warden)

1879305547.Skill_Desc: Rains arrows down upon your enemies, allowing you to hit multiple targets.

1879335499.Skill_Desc: Summons a little mûmak to keep you company.

1879345099.Skill_Desc: A token of thanks for your actions before the Battle of the Black Gate.
1879345099.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available by completing the Deed: The Road to Mordor.

1879352139.Skill_Desc: A pony from the Summer Festival.
1879352139.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available during the Farmer's Faire Festival for Mithril Coins.

1879368651.Skill_Desc: Brings out a silver goat kid to keep you company.

1879374539.Skill_Desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Skarháld.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879391435.Skill_Desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Victory into battle. This banner reduces power costs of those around it.
1879391435.Skill_Name: Call to Arms: Herald of Victory (Elvish Swordswoman)

1879400139.Skill_Desc: Your companion projects a vine that can quickly choke a target.

1879411787.Skill_Desc: Well versed in the grappler's tricks, Brawlers can quickly slip out of holds, traps, and other attempts to constrain them.\n\nRecover from being dazed, stunned, or knocked down.

1879447371.Skill_Desc: Brings out a friendly corgi to keep you company.
1879447371.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Limited time availability in Traveller's and Adventurer's Lootboxes

1879452363.Skill_Desc: Summons a beautiful stork to accompany you on your journeys.

1879460555.Skill_Desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Carn Dûm.

1879463371.Skill_Desc: Summons an energetic young goat to accompany you on your journeys.
1879463371.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available through barter during the Anniversary Festival.

1879489227.Skill_Desc: Your companion lets out a terrifying roar, gaining an offensive bonus for each enemy in range.

1879500363.Skill_Desc: Summons a friendly frog to accompany you in your hunt.
1879500363.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Limited time availability for Figments of Splendour.

1879506251.Skill_Desc: You're able to quickly return to Dun Shûma in Khûd Zagin in the Ikorbân Valley. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879506635.Skill_Desc: Call upon the Darkness beneath the north mountains to weaken the foes of Angmar.

1879509067.Skill_Desc: A Piercing Arrow wounds and dismays your foe, causing subsequent ranged attacks to restore your Morale for a brief time.

1879528267.Skill_Desc: Using fell knowledge and potions, breathe a gout of flame in front of you.
